name: credit-g
description: This dataset classifies people described by a set of attributes as good or bad credit risks.This dataset comes with a cost matrix:Good  Bad (predicted)  Good   0    1   (actual)Bad    5    0  It is worse to class a customer as good when they are bad (5), than it is to class a customer as bad when they are good (1).
creator: Yoontae Hwang, Youngbin Lee, Yongjae Lee
citation: Yoontae Hwang, Youngbin Lee, Yongjae Lee,Semi-Supervised Learning for Tabular Datasets with Continuous and Categorical Variables, Archive, 2023
